author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
We tested PVC vs composite decking using a 30-lb weight to measure deflection. PVC bent twice as much as solid composite, and scalloped composite landed in the middle — here’s what that means for joist spacing and deck framing. Watch the full decking comparison video on the channel now. If you found this video helpful, please subscribe. Hope you enjoy. Cheers!
